title: Session page Overview: clear the leftovers and make the child list clear
description: Owner (2026-10-26) reviewing /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/v-9dvbbrn/ after the blank-page fix. Screenshot at desktop width shows: (1) a white empty sliver still sits between the title and the tab row; (2) console 400 for /ai-logs/v-9dvbbrn/session, still requested for a voice session; (3) '124 tasks drawn / 1 of 124 done' while the four child sessions each say 'no tasks yet' (this session has about a dozen of its own); (4) the toggle button reads 'Ranked by cost - newest first' and flips to 'newest first - ranked by cost': owner cannot tell what it does, 'a very unclear UI'. It should say what it IS (the current sort, e.g. 'Sorted by cost' with a clear way to switch), or be a plain two-option control; (5) a list should be titled for what it lists: 'Child sessions' (4), not 'N child sessions · N tasks drawn'. (6) the title is the bare id until the naming fix is live (Servex restart pending). Not yet checked: Timeline and Tasks tabs, 400px width.
